name: export_views
description: Project: export all non-template views to a JSON file ON DISK. Per view: viewId, name, viewType, scale (null-safe), viewTemplateName, isOnSheet, sheetId, sheetNumber. Also includes a viewportMap (viewportId -> viewId) that joins against sheets_views.json viewportIds. Only a summary returns through MCP. outputPath is a caller-supplied absolute path.
